The final count was **11,418 records**, bounded by Entrez entry date through 2017-12-14; no publication-date limit was applied. Block totals were education **1,443,791**, food/diet/nutrition **1,590,321**, population **3,392,932**, and school/classroom setting **316,648**. The [audit](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-9c6e3b4b8b2f6f5e/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T134307Z/work/audit.md) has the complete line-by-line counts and translations.

## Validation and limitations

Seven records screened from a targeted PubMed pilot were added as a development set. The strategy retrieved **7/7 (100% relative recall)** against that set; this is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity. No held-out set or included-study benchmark was available. The search has an accepted risk that its school-setting block could miss eligible studies where school delivery appears only in full text or is poorly indexed. The internal PRESS-structured critique was same-context QA, not specialist peer review.

The draft needs **PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**.
